data.one_liner: Build flexible, flat layout hierarchies with constraints similar to Android's ConstraintLayout.
data.what_it_does: Provides a powerful Stack-like widget that allows building complex layouts using directional constraints relative to parents, siblings, or IDs. Features O(n) layout time complexity without requiring linear equation solving.
use_when: You need to avoid deep nesting ('nested hell') in complex Flutter layouts.
You want precise control over element positioning using relative constraints and biases.
avoid_when: You need built-in layout chains (not yet natively supported).
You require two-way constraints between child elements directly.
strengths: O(n) layout time complexity with high performance.
Extensive feature set including guidelines, barriers, percentage layout, and grid helpers.
Flat code hierarchy reduces build and render times.
weaknesses: Chains are not yet natively supported.
